x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change ori-adoption task 1.1 (REQ-ORIA-002). The additive schema deltas that let council information (ORI) be stored in decidiq's own Popolo-aligned schemas: new properties only, nothing renamed or removed, so every existing object stays valid. The three new enum values (Meeting.meetingType informational-session, Meeting.lifecycle cancelled, GovernanceBody.bodyType political-group) are in decidesk_register.json itself: the fragment merger appends lists while other readers of the fragments replace them by index, so an enum list in a fragment would mean two different things. Named to sort after every other fragment, so its schema versions are the merged ones; each is one minor above the highest version any file declares for that schema.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: The documents attached to this agenda item (one-to-many).

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: A free-text category of the document, as the source that published it names it.

url.title: URL
url.description: Where the document can be downloaded (schema.org url).

partyResults.title: Party results
partyResults.description: How each party voted, as a party-level aggregate. Kept as recorded: it is never decomposed into individual votes.

party.title: Party
party.description: The party: a GovernanceBody reference, or its name when no body is known.

seatCount.title: Seats
seatCount.description: The seats the party held in this vote.

subjectDecision.title: Decision
subjectDecision.description: The decision this round voted on, for a round recorded without a decision route (for example an imported historical vote).

seatCount.title: Seats
seatCount.description: The seats the body holds, as a stored count for a body whose member list is incomplete.

coalitionRole.title: Coalition role
coalitionRole.description: Whether a political group is in the coalition or the opposition.
